title: Ultrafast synthesis of NiCo alloy catalysts by Joule heating for the electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution reaction
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01158B, Paper
Wence Ma, Zhiyuan Niu, Haidong Wang, Jinlong Li, Kaixin Zhu, Weiguang Ma, Xu Zong
Ultrafast Joule heating successfully produced small, well-dispersed NiCo alloy nanoparticles. The obtained catalyst shows markedly higher hydrogen evolution reaction activity than those synthesized by traditional heating.
